solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: One who kills when soldiers do wrong

parts.note: 'as' can mean 'when', as in 'as I left'
the Special Air Service, the British special forces regiment
to sin is to do wrong

explanation.surface: A grim reflection that killing begins when soldiers misbehave.
explanation.definitionFit: An assassin is a murderer, typically of a prominent person, so a killer by definition.

clue.text: Assistant promoting last part of plan

indicators.note: promoting moves something upward, here the final letter of a word goes to the front

parts.note: an idea is a plan or scheme

explanation.surface: An assistant is pushing the final stage of a project forward.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue, promoting the last letter lifts it to the top: the A of IDEA moves to the front to give AIDE.
explanation.definitionFit: An aide is a helper or assistant, especially to a politician or senior official.

clue.text: Health resort in country

parts.note: a spa is a resort with mineral springs
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone recommends a health resort located in a particular country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in country' reads as a location, but 'in' is just letters and 'country' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Spain is a nation of south-western Europe, so an example of a country.

clue.text: Simple characterisation of, eg, poetry isn't wrong

indicators.note: something wrong is out of order, so the letters before it must be rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written, apostrophe dropped

explanation.surface: A critic objects that labelling poetry, for instance, as simple isn't right.
explanation.definitionFit: Stereotyping is reducing a person or thing to an oversimplified, standard image, a crude characterisation.

clue.text: Redevelopment of mine secures company revenue

indicators.note: to secure is to hold fast, so one part is held inside another
redevelopment rebuilds something in a new form, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
CO is the standard abbreviation for company

explanation.surface: Reopening a mine brings in money for the business that runs it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Redevelopment of mine' sounds like property, but it only reorders the four letters, which then split round the company.
explanation.definitionFit: Income is money received, and revenue is a business's earnings, so the two are synonyms.

clue.text: I'm disgusted about leader of socialist party

indicators.note: about means around, so one part wraps round another

parts.note: bah is an exclamation of disgust or contempt

indicators.note: the leader is the one at the front, so only the opening letter is kept

parts.note: opening letter of the word

explanation.surface: A voter expresses disgust at the head of a left-wing political party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'socialist party' looks like politics, but party is the definition in its festive sense.
explanation.definitionFit: A bash is informal for a party or lively celebration.

clue.text: Great gallery means to project information

parts.note: ace is slang for excellent or great
the Tate is the famous London art gallery

explanation.surface: An art gallery is praised as a great way to display information.
explanation.walkthrough: Acetate sheets were the transparencies laid on overhead projectors in classrooms and meetings.
explanation.definitionFit: An acetate is a clear plastic sheet written on and shown through an overhead projector, a presentation medium.

clue.text: Had an effect before other changes up to now

indicators.note: before places the first piece ahead of the second in the answer

parts.note: something that hit had an impact

indicators.note: changes signals that the word before it alters its letter order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A policy had an impact ahead of further reforms, up to the present.
explanation.definitionFit: Hitherto is a formal adverb meaning until this point in time, so 'so far'.

clue.text: Popular publicity item for launching entertaining book is unacceptable

indicators.note: to entertain a guest is to take them in, so one piece sits inside another

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
an ad is an advertisement
a missile is something launched or fired
B is the abbreviation for book

explanation.surface: A promotional gimmick at a book launch is judged out of order.
explanation.walkthrough: 'launching' suggests a book launch, but 'item for launching' is a rocket; B goes inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Inadmissible means not allowed or not acceptable, as with evidence a court refuses.

clue.text: Doctor replaces front of record cover

indicators.note: replacing the front swaps the opening letter of a word for something else

parts.note: DR is the abbreviation for doctor
to tape is to record

explanation.surface: A doctor swaps out the front sleeve of a vinyl record.
explanation.walkthrough: The T at the front of TAPE gives way to DR.
explanation.definitionFit: To drape is to cover loosely with cloth, and a drape is itself a curtain or covering.

clue.text: Call into question tax introduced by Tory

indicators.note: being introduced by someone means they come first, so that piece goes in front

parts.note: Con is short for Conservative, and a Tory is a Conservative
to tax someone is to strain or test them

explanation.surface: A voter challenges a tax brought in by a Conservative government.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tax' is not a levy here but the verb meaning to strain, as in 'taxing'.
explanation.definitionFit: To contest a decision is to dispute or challenge it, a synonym of questioning it.

clue.text: Football team meets referee halfway

parts.note: Inter Milan, the Italian football club
to referee a dispute is to mediate in it

explanation.surface: A football team's players encounter the referee at the halfway line.
explanation.walkthrough: 'referee' is a verb here, the act of arbitrating, not the official on the pitch.
explanation.definitionFit: Intermediate describes something in the middle between two stages, lying midway.

clue.text: What flies to display skill?

parts.note: to air something is to show it publicly
craft is skill in making things

explanation.surface: A question about what a pilot or bird does to show off its talent.
explanation.definitionFit: An aircraft is any machine that travels through the air, the thing that flies.

clue.text: Stimulate ability to understand things we hear

indicators.note: things heard rather than read point to how a word sounds when spoken

parts.note: insight is the power of understanding

explanation.surface: A teacher encourages the faculty of understanding what we're told.
explanation.definitionFit: To incite is to stir up or provoke, which is to rouse or spur into action.

clue.text: Alleged Charlie was first to catch train

parts.note: Charlie is C in the NATO phonetic alphabet

indicators.note: catching something takes hold of it, so one piece is gripped inside another

parts.note: whoever led was out in front
to train a gun is to aim it

explanation.surface: Someone says Charlie got to the station ahead so as to make the train.
explanation.walkthrough: 'train' looks like transport, but it is the verb for pointing a weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: Claimed means asserted without proof, which is what alleged means.

clue.text: Order straightforward guide

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to command or instruct
third meaning: to show the way

explanation.surface: An instruction to request a simple manual or handbook.
explanation.walkthrough: Three separate meanings rather than two: a verb, an adjective, and another verb.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means to command, plain-speaking or honest, and to steer or conduct someone.

clue.text: Get rid of old lady's area of expertise

parts.note: to do someone in is to kill them, getting rid of them
old lady is slang for mother, MA

explanation.surface: A grumble about dismissing an elderly woman's specialist field.
explanation.walkthrough: No word signals the insertion: a phrasal verb like 'do in' naturally splits round its object, as in 'do someone in', meaning kill.
explanation.definitionFit: A domain is a field of knowledge or activity, someone's sphere or specialism.

clue.text: Defends joint title

parts.note: to champion a cause is to defend it
the hip is a joint of the body

explanation.surface: A sporting pair retains the title they share.
explanation.walkthrough: 'joint title' suggests a shared crown, but joint is the body part.
explanation.definitionFit: A championship is a title won in a competition, the status of champion.

clue.text: Bar selling other drinks

indicators.note: something that drinks takes liquid in, so the letters sit swallowed inside the words around them

parts.note: letters inside the phrase across the word gap

explanation.surface: A pub serving rival brands of beverages.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bar' and 'drinks' set a pub scene, but bar is a bar of metal.
explanation.definitionFit: An ingot is a block or bar of cast metal, typically gold or silver.

clue.text: Famous performer's backing singers

indicators.note: backing means going backwards, which in a down clue reads the word from the bottom up

parts.note: informers sing to the police, and an informer is a rat

explanation.surface: A celebrity's backing vocalists.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing singers' is a music phrase, but 'singers' are grasses who talk to the police.
explanation.definitionFit: A star is a celebrated actor, singer or entertainer, a famous name.

clue.text: Ace airmen crashed somewhere in the Caucasus

indicators.note: something crashed is smashed up, so the letters are wrecked and reassembled

parts.note: A is the abbreviation for ace in cards
taken as written

explanation.surface: Top pilots came down in the mountains between the Black and Caspian Seas.
explanation.definitionFit: Armenia is a country in the Caucasus region, so an example of a place there.

clue.text: Scrap outside work biased individual

indicators.note: outside means surrounding, so one piece wraps round another

parts.note: a bit is a scrap or small piece
to go is to work or function, as a machine does

explanation.surface: Throw away an outdoor job done by a prejudiced person.
explanation.definitionFit: A bigot is someone intolerant of others' opinions or groups, a prejudiced person.

clue.text: Change reflected ups and downs in the main

definitions.text: ups and downs in the main

indicators.note: a mirror reflection shows things the other way round, so the letters run backwards

parts.note: to edit text is to change it

explanation.surface: Change mirrored the highs and lows, on the whole.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in the main' means 'mostly', but here the main is the sea, as in the Spanish Main.
explanation.definitionFit: The tide is the regular rise and fall of the sea's level, its rising and falling.

clue.text: Somehow trace son and parent?

indicators.note: somehow means in some unspecified way, so the letters are put into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A genealogist tries to track down a son and his father.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that a parent is only an example of a forebear.
explanation.definitionFit: A parent is the nearest kind of forebear, one from whom a person is descended.
